title: Shinji Kanda Reel

scenes.vo: Kartu Giratina ini salah satu kartu paling ikonik
scenes.caption: One of the most iconic cards
But the artist behind it is even more interesting.

scenes.name: SHINJI KANDA
scenes.vo: Namanya Shinji Kanda. Lahir tahun seribu sembilan ratus delapan puluh enam di Kyoto, Jepang.
scenes.caption: Meet Shinji Kanda. Born in 1986 in Kyoto, Japan.

scenes.vo: Kartu pertamanya, Magmar, digambar pakai pensil warna di atas plastik,
scenes.caption: His first card, Magmar, was drawn in colored pencil on plastic,
then heated until the plastic shrank.

scenes.vo: Kartu Magneton-nya? Teksturnya dari aluminium foil yang diremas, lalu di-scan.
scenes.caption: His Magneton? Its texture came from crumpled aluminum foil, scanned.

scenes.vo: Karyanya yang paling diburu: Giratina V, Magikarp, dan Roaring Moon ex.
scenes.caption: His most wanted: Giratina V, Magikarp, and Roaring Moon ex.

scenes.vo: Kolektor sampai punya istilah "Shinji Tax": harga ekstra untuk kartu apa pun yang dia gambar.
scenes.caption: Collectors call it the "Shinji Tax": a premium on any card he draws.

scenes.vo: Dan kabar baiknya, banyak kartunya ready di Kard Avenue.
scenes.caption: Good news: lots of his cards are in stock at Kard Avenue.

scenes.name: SHINJI KANDA
scenes.vo: Di luar Pokémon, dia pelukis galeri yang rutin pameran tunggal di Kyoto.
scenes.caption: Beyond Pokémon, he is a gallery artist with regular solo shows in Kyoto.

scenes.vo: Dan dia juga menggambar Pikachu untuk set ulang tahun ketiga puluh Pokémon.
scenes.caption: He also drew Pikachu for Pokémon's 30th Celebration set.

scenes.vo: Follow Kard Avenue untuk cerita kartu lainnya, dan download aplikasinya sekarang.
scenes.caption: Follow Kard Avenue for more card stories, and download the app now.
